title: Statistical attribute alignment for black-box generative AI via output post-processing

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating generated images of professionals and groups for perceived gender using a vision-language model and measuring the statistical divergence of the outputs from a specified target distribution before and after algorithmic post-processing.

Annotating generated images of professionals and groups for perceived race/ethnicity using a vision-language model and measuring the statistical divergence of the outputs from a specified target distribution before and after algorithmic post-processing.

Annotating generated images for perceived age categories (e.g., young, old) using a vision-language model and measuring the statistical divergence of the outputs from a specified target distribution before and after algorithmic post-processing.

Generating synthetic patient personas via a language model, mapping generated ZIP codes to CDC Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) quartiles, and measuring the distribution of socioeconomic indicators (e.g., housing-cost burden, uninsurance rates).
